recipes.name: Warm Tahini Chocolate Banana Wrap
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the tahini, maple syrup, and cocoa powder.
Slice the banana in half, then into strips, lengthwise.
Spread the tahini mixture evenly on the tortilla and then place the tortilla on a large pan over medium heat. Top with the banana slices and chopped hazelnuts.

When the tortilla starts to become golden, gently fold the tortilla in half and press down with the back of a spatula. You can also roll the filled tortilla into a burrito and toast it in the pan for a neater "to-go" option.
Remove the tortilla from the pan, cut it in half, and add your desired toppings. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Our medium tortillas measure about 8 inches (20 cm) in diameter.
